description: Exact US marketplace fees, payout and profit for one sale on one platform (eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Whatnot, Depop, Etsy, Facebook Marketplace, Amazon, Grailed, Reverb, TCGplayer, TikTok Shop, Vinted). Same numbers as the Fliprofit calculators. Returns a fee breakdown, payout, profit, margin, ROI, the official fee source and a link to the matching fliprofit.com calculator.

itemCost.description: What you paid for the item, USD (default 0).

options.description: Optional platform-specific options. Allowed: ebay: category (one of most|books|cards|guitars|jewelry|watches|bags|sneakers), adRate (number); whatnot: category (one of sports|tcg|fashion|collectibles|coins|other), tier (one of 0|1|2|3|4|5|6), highValue (true|false); depop: boost (true|false), ownLabel (true|false); etsy: offsiteAds (one of 12|15|none); facebook: mode (one of shipped|local); amazon: category (one of everything|toys|sports|tools|videogames|consoles|electronics|clothing|beauty|watches|media), plan (one of individual|pro), fbaFee (number); grailed: grailedLabel (true|false), processing (one of us|intl|legacy); reverb: preferred (true|false); tcgplayer: sellerType (one of level|pro); tiktok: category (one of most|collectibles|preowned|finejewelry); vinted: bump (number).

otherCost.description: Packaging, promotion and other costs, USD (default 0).

shipCharged.description: Shipping the buyer paid you, USD (default 0).

taxRate.description: Buyer sales tax percent, e.g. 8 (default 0). Used where the platform charges fees on tax.

name: calculate_fees
title: Calculate reseller fees for one platform
